structure: Part 5 mined all 23 traces of origin.fit.spec.js in three describe blocks: 'origin feature' (12 tests, spec lines 106-308), 'origin country and region validation' (9 tests, lines 553-695) and 'origin internal reference validation' (2 tests, lines 728-750), plus the spec file itself for titles and assertions. Each trace zip had been unpacked into the part5 working folder (a01-a12 = origin feature in read order, v01-v09 = country and region validation, r01-r02 = internal reference validation); each folder's test title was confirmed from its 0-trace.trace before mining. For every trace the test-runner actions (test.trace), the DOM snapshots (1-trace.trace frame-snapshots, rendered with jq) and the network log (1-trace.network, including POST form bodies, status and Location) were read. No test step in any of the 23 traces recorded an error. Refs below name the trace by its zip hash (for example 'origin-f-184d5') and either the test step id (pw:api@N / expect@N) or the library snapshot call id (call@N). Pages reached, in order: dashboard /live-animals -> 'Start a new notification' POST /live-animals/notifications (302) -> origin page /live-animals/notifications/{reference}/origin ('Origin of the import', always first) -> on a valid save with a country, /commodities ('What are you importing?'); with no country, the notification hub /live-animals/notifications/{reference} ('Overview'). Also touched in passing: the hub (via Back and 'Cancel and return to overview'), the dashboard (via Back) and /notification-view ('Review your notification', only its origin rows are claimed here). Conditional surface: the region of origin code box is revealed only under 'Yes'; the fixed country prefix beside it appears only once a country value is held or submitted. Error states driven: out-of-list country, invalid region requirement option, Yes with empty code, code over 5 characters, internal reference over 58 characters; every error re-render answered HTTP 400. The country type-ahead's own behaviour (filtering, focus listing) is part 6 and is not claimed here beyond what these traces render.
